name: Saatlik Motor v1
daily_list: At each UTC midnight use the daily candle that has just closed. Same list until next midnight. The hourly candle closing at midnight may use that new, already known daily list.
monthly_universe: Previous 30 complete UTC days of quote volume; top30; archived delisted names included. Stablecoin registry only. No additional age or trend filter in universe; indicators need their mathematical warmup.
ema: SMA seed of first period closes; alpha 2/(period+1). Wilder ATR14 with first14 true ranges SMA seed. A missing candle starts a new contiguous seed segment; no price imputation.
volume: Signal volume >= 1.5 * mean of previous20 volumes, signal excluded.
quota: At most one accepted plan per symbol per UTC signal-close date, independently in MAIN, CONTROL_A, CONTROL_B. No additional portfolio position limits.
control_a: Opposite-direction24h breakouts in coins on a daily LONG or SHORT list; same monthly top30, volume condition, stop, target, time exit, costs and funding.
control_b: LONG or SHORT24h breakouts in monthly top30 coins on neither directional list. Daily data must be valid. Same plan and execution rules. Not selected using subsequent returns.
entry: Next hourly open. Nonpositive price/risk/target is an invalid plan, not a new strategy filter.
timeout: Exactly entry+2h: opening price of the hourly candle at that boundary. Stops/targets apply to the two preceding hours. A stop gap exits at the open; a favorable target gap exits at target conservatively.
ambiguous_hour: Official1m replay. Missing/inconsistent1m => STOP. Both hit in same1m => STOP. A single-hit hourly exit is timestamped at hour-end minus1ms; funding settles at hourly boundaries.
funding: Actual published signed rates on constant entry notional; LONG pays positive rate, SHORT receives. Entry<settlement<=exit. Normalize millisecond settlement jitter to second. Series must bracket trade and have no gap over8h. Missing history is UNVERIFIED, never zero or an assumed rate.
approval: Live requires GEÇTİ in report and subsequent explicit user approval. No schedule in active workflow until then.
success: MAIN>=200 closed measured trades; mean net%>0 at0.30% and0.60% costs; MAIN mean net% greater than both control means. No parameter changes or reruns after completed result. Missing data disclosed separately.
